head.t: Harrison.ai wins direct-award chest X-ray AI contract at Somerset NHS Foundation Trust
head.x: Somerset NHS Foundation Trust has made a direct award to Harrison-AI Medical UK Ltd for a chest X-ray AI solution and radiology AI platform, covering integration with existing imaging systems and consolidation of radiology AI tools under one managed platform.

head.t: Framework ending 31 July 2027: Digital Diagnostic Solutions
head.x: Named on NHS Supply Chain's own contract launch brief for this framework, as "Harrison-AI Medical UK Ltd". 54 suppliers on the framework.
